why: All three checks pass and the refutation attempts all fail. (1) QUOTE VERBATIM: cloud-environments.md:392 reads exactly 'To persist environment variables for subsequent Bash commands, write to the file at `$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE`. See [SessionStart hooks](/docs/en/hooks#sessionstart) for details.' The second sentence of the two-sentence line is a cross-reference and does not reverse the conclusion. (2) SCOPE REFUTATION FAILS: the page is otherwise about Anthropic-hosted cloud VMs, and the coverage map row 126 verdicts it 'вне продукта' — but that same row admits 'вердикт записан, страница не открывалась' (recorded without opening the page), and reading it shows this sentence cross-references a NON-cloud mechanism. hooks.md:1018 states 'SessionStart hooks have access to the `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` environment variable' with no cloud qualifier, and hooks.md:1056 extends it to Setup, CwdChanged and FileChanged. So the mechanism is a local-hooks contract on a surface we do ship, not a hosted-product feature. It is also not a de-brand/dropped-subscription product difference. (3) NOT AN OWNER DECISION: none of the nine dated decisions in inert-worklist.md §3 (seatbelt wildcard, availableModels/isManagedModelAllowed, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath, listSessionSummaries) concerns CLAUDE_ENV_FILE. (4) ABSENCE HOLDS with `grep -rani -a` over source: the only ENV_FILE hits are inside the bundled `uv` binary blob under apps/electron/**/bin/darwin-arm64/uv; positive control CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR matches TypeScript at runtime-skill-content.ts:137 and native-sources.ts:726. (5) CONSEQUENCE VERIFIED SEPARATELY FROM THE IDENTIFIER, one layer up and one down: SessionManager.pluginCommandHookRunner (SessionManager.ts:4184) builds the hook child env solely through buildHookCommandEnv(event, input, action.env) (hook-command.ts:664), commented in-source as 'The environment is a pure function of the event, the input and the host-built action env'. buildHookCommandEnv (hook-command.ts:46-81) seeds NESSY_EVENT/NESSY_EVENT_DATA, inherits only SAFE_INHERITED_ENV_KEYS = ['HOME','PATH','SHELL','TMPDIR','TEMP','TMP'] (:34), adds ~14 NESSY_* payload keys, then merges action.env (where the plugin root/data and NESSY_PROJECT_DIR/CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pairs arrive via pluginRuntimeEnvForProfile). No env-file path is created, exported, or read back, and no Bash preamble sources one. Nothing upstream already handles it. (6) INDEPENDENTLY PRE-RECORDED as a real gap: plans/2026-07-29-hook-context-injection.md:300 lists '`CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` — documented, not implemented — no env-file preamble is sourced before Bash tool calls, so the direnv recipe’s SessionStart and CwdChanged hooks run and their writes are never read', and specs/2026-07-26-r-queue-doc-verification.md:463 calls it 'an environment-injection channel with no equivalent on our side'. Crucially this row is NOT marked 'Kept deliberately' — the sibling row at :598 on the same list is, which shows the plan distinguishes the two, so this one is an open gap and not a decision.
correctedState: Confirmed as a gap, with three corrections to the evidence and one widening of scope. (a) WRONG LINE POINTER: hook-command.ts:164 is not the env allowlist — it is the string 'NESSY_PROJECT_DIR' inside EXEC_FORM_PATH_PLACEHOLDERS (:161-170), the exec-form placeholder-substitution list. The actual env builder is buildHookCommandEnv at hook-command.ts:46-81, whose inherited set is SAFE_INHERITED_ENV_KEYS at :34; cite those instead. (b) THE SECOND EVIDENCE ITEM IS LOGICALLY IRRELEVANT: hook-decision-contract.ts:85 (SessionStart = context-only) is factually accurate but describes the stdout JSON decision surface. CLAUDE_ENV_FILE is not a stdout field at all — it is an inbound env var naming a file the hook appends `export` lines to. Giving SessionStart a full decision surface would not close this gap, and the context-only classification is not its cause; the cause is simply that buildHookCommandEnv never mints the file and nothing sources it before Bash. (c) WRONG PAGE OF RECORD: the divergence is really a hooks.md contract (§ 'Persist environment variables', hooks.md:1018-1056), which cloud-environments.md:392 merely cross-references. Filing it under cloud-environments risks it being closed by that page's standing 'out of product' scope verdict. (d) SCOPE IS WIDER THAN SessionStart: hooks.md:1056 — '`CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` is available for SessionStart, Setup, CwdChanged, and FileChanged hooks. Other hook types don't have access to this variable.' Nessy emits CwdChanged and FileChanged (plugins/hooks-automation.ts:392-393) and Setup (automations/types.ts:152), so an imported Claude plugin hook on any of those four events also finds $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE unset. Fix shape: mint a per-session temp file, export its path as NESSY_ENV_FILE plus the CLAUDE_ENV_FILE compat alias in buildHookCommandEnv for exactly those four events, and source it as a preamble on subsequent Bash tool calls.
